find-my-wallets-confirm-description: Switch to the wallet starting {{prefix}}? Your wallet seeds are never deleted, but your transaction history is rescanned from the blockchain, which can take a while.
find-my-wallets-description: Tari Universe can list the wallets whose seeds are still stored on this computer, including any your current settings no longer point at. Choose one to use it again. Your wallet seeds are never deleted and no seed words are shown here; switching wallets rescans your transaction history.
find-my-wallets-error-generic: Tari Universe could not finish that. Your wallet seeds are untouched. Please try again, or open Settings to export your logs.
find-my-wallets-error-keyring: Tari Universe could not read this computer's secure storage. Your wallet seeds are untouched. Please try again, or open Settings to export your logs.
find-my-wallets-error-pin-locked: Too many incorrect PIN attempts. Your PIN is locked for a short while; please try again later.
find-my-wallets-error-pin-locked-seconds: Too many incorrect PIN attempts. Your PIN is locked for another {{seconds}} seconds.
find-my-wallets-none: No wallet seeds were found in this computer's secure storage.
find-my-wallets-status-unreadable: Could not be read from secure storage
find-my-wallets-unsupported: Tari Universe cannot list the secure storage on this operating system. Your wallet seeds are untouched; please restore with your seed words or contact support.
not-installed-in-applications-directory: Oops! Tari Universe needs to live in the Applications directory. Mind installing it there?
please-try-again-later: Please try again later. If the problem persists, please contact us.
waiting-for-confirmations: Waiting for {{ total }} block confirmations ({{ confirmations }} of {{ total }} confirmed)
wallet-recovery-config-corrupted-descrip: Tari Universe could not read your wallet settings file, so it did not open your wallet and did not create a new one. The damaged file was kept as config_wallet.json.corrupted.<timestamp> and a config_wallet.json.recovery_required marker keeps this screen up until valid settings are restored. Your seed words are untouched in this computer's secure storage. Mining and telemetry are paused. Open Settings to export your logs, or restore your wallet with your seed words.
wallet-recovery-config-corrupted-title: Wallet settings could not be read
wallet-recovery-description: Tari Universe could not verify your wallet. Mining and telemetry are paused until this is resolved. Open Settings to export your logs or contact support.
wallet-recovery-init-failed-description: Tari Universe could not open your wallet, so it has not started mining. Nothing has been changed or deleted, and this screen stays up until the wallet opens. Restart Tari Universe to try again, or open Settings to export your logs.
wallet-recovery-legacy-config-descriptio: Tari Universe found files from an older wallet on this computer but could not read them, so it has not created a new wallet. Nothing has been changed or deleted. Open Settings to export your logs, or restore your wallet with your seed words.
wallet-recovery-legacy-config-title: Older wallet files could not be read
wallet-recovery-legacy-seed-description: Tari Universe found a wallet from an older version but could not unlock its seed on this computer. Your wallet is intact and its address is known, and nothing has been changed or deleted, but this screen stays up and mining is paused until the seed can be unlocked. Use Find my wallets to look for it on this computer, or open Settings to export your logs.
wallet-recovery-legacy-seed-title: Older wallet needs your seed words
wallet-recovery-seed-unavailable-descrip: Your wallet's seed could not be read from this computer's secure storage. Your wallet is intact and its address is known, and nothing has been changed or deleted, but this screen stays up and mining is paused until the seed can be read again. Use Find my wallets to look for it on this computer, or open Settings to export your logs.
webgl-not-supported: WebGL not supported. Disabled visual mode.
